The planner then added Princess and Ice Spirits behind them. With no budget left I couldn't respond, and the damage passed 450 in the last few seconds.

Spending 4 elixir on it left too little for the second threat in the other lane, which is what this scenario tests. A better plan was probably to Log the Barrel (2), answer the Gang cheaply in the other lane with Ice Spirits and Skeletons (1 each), and keep the leftover elixir for whatever came next.

The 21 HP left after Fireball needed a fast second hit sent early, and Ice Spirits placed on my side of the river targeted the nearby Giant rather than running to the enemy tower. I also used the Cannon to defend and then waited for the Hog. Sending the Hog right after the Fireball and holding the Log as the finisher sooner would likely have won the race.
